titles.romaji: Hana no Joshi Ana: Newscaster Etsuko
titles.native: 花の女子アナ ニュースキャスター・悦子

description:
Tokyo Flower TV's star newscaster, Etsuko Yamanobe is known as the best among the newscasters, with top-notch judgment and analytical skills. One day, there is a hostage siege. A man who was fired from the finance company he worked for breaks into the president's house in revenge, barricading himself inside and taking the daughter hostage. Etsuko, who is broadcasting the incident, decides to go to the scene herself to negotiate with the man. She reads the news with a serious expression, while under the table, she is playing with herself with her legs wide open. Of course, that's on air too… When the broadcast ends, Etsuko teams up with the armed security service to begin negotiations for the hostage. What is the full story behind the broadcast that this unconventional newscaster wants to deliver using every means possible…?!

(Source: OceanVeil)
